def unique(items):

```python
def _fence(line):     # detects ``` / ~~~ fences (≤3 spaces indent, 3+ markers)
def toc(markdown):
    entries = []
    fence = None
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        marker = _fence(line)
        if fence is None:
            if marker is not None:
                fence = marker          # open a block, emit nothing for it
                continue
            indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
            if indent > 3:
                continue
            text = line[indent:]
            level = len(text) - len(text.lstrip("#"))
            if level < 1 or level > 3:
                continue
            if len(text) <= level or text[level] != " ":
                continue                # "#hashtag", "#" -> not headings
            title = text[level:].strip()
            if not title:
                continue                # "#   " -> ignored
            entries.append((level, title))
        else:
            char, length = fence
            if (marker is not None and marker[0] == char
                    and marker[1] >= length
                    and not line.strip().lstrip(char).strip()):
                fence = None            # only a bare fence of same char/length closes
    return entries
```

def run(transitions, start, events):
    if start not in transitions:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown start state: {start!r}")

    state = start
    for event in events:
        state_transitions = transitions.get(state, {})

import re
from collections import Counter


def top(text, count):
    if count <= 0:
        return []
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+", text.lower())

# One "number + optional spaces + unit" part, e.g. "30m", "30 m", " 1h".
_PART_RE = re.compile(r"\s*(\d+)\s*([smh])")

# A valid input is one or more parts plus optional trailing spaces.
_FULL_RE = re.compile(r"(?:\s*\d+\s*[smh])+\s*")


def parse(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError("duration must be a string, got %r" % (text,))
    if not _FULL_RE.fullmatch(text):
        raise ValueError("invalid duration: %r" % (text,))

    total = 0
    seen = set()
    for number, unit in _PART_RE.findall(text):
        if unit in seen:
            raise ValueError("repeated unit %r in duration: %r" % (unit, text))
        seen.add(unit)
        total += int(number) * _UNIT_SECONDS[unit]
    return total
